data.name: Star Array
data.detailed_description:
You are a lone fighter, yet an entire fleet. You are a drifter, yet a galactic governor.

In the vast sandbox universe of Star Array, the laws of survival and conquest are as brutal as they are captivating. In the beginning, you may only prowl the outskirts of heavily fortified enemy bases like a hyena, hunting down lone patrol ships for bounties. But once you return to your homeport laden with spoils, and tow heavy firepower modules and tactical turrets to deploy at strategic chokepoints, your interwoven crossfire will turn any passing fool into an endless resource ATM. The balance of power begins to shift.

Once you master the technology to capture and retrofit enemy bases, massive interstellar assembly lines will roar to life for you. An overwhelming swarm of allied warships will obliterate any resistance in your path, permanently reversing the roles of hunter and prey.

This is more than just a clash of bullet hell and evasive maneuvers; it is a grand game of resources, technology, and territorial dominance.

Commander, ignite your engines. Go conquer your next starport!

data.short_description: In this hybrid space shooter and 4X strategy sandbox, start as a lone fighter and evolve into a galactic commander. Tow modular turrets to build a mobile fortress, loot resources, capture enemy starports, and command massive allied fleets to conquer the stars!
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
